title: The target form of the case list is not fixed by any source: the row shape, the account-data owner in the read path, the freshness stamp, the removal of the lake path and the ownership of the reconciliation
source: Legacy story RWB-E1-002 sections 1, 3, 4, 7, 10, 12 and 13; Functional Specifications by Module v6, FSD P3 v4 A1.5, A2.18, A2.19; Technical Specifications by Module v5, TSD P3 v3 T-A.2 (API-P3-001) and T5.2; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 (GET /cases, its X-Data-As-Of header and the Case schema); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 3, 8 and 10; Template and Rules v1 R3 (default ruling: the case list API is P3 rwb-case) and R5.5 DP-17
section: s1 Story; s3 Preconditions; s7 Acceptance criteria; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s12.5 Workflows and activities; s12.6 Schedules; s12.7 Tables owned; s13 Solution plan
description: The legacy story fixes the list as one row per open case and linked account, built by a Quartz step of JOB-04 in the P1 data engine, joined to v_ace_account and v_ace_efs_action, written to case_list_row with UNIQUE (business_date), reconciled by REC-01 and pushed to the data lake for the Power BI data set 'Case list v1'. The target changes five facts of that design and no source read for this story fixes the replacement. First, the row: the technical specification and the API specification publish GET /cases with a CasePage of Case items, which is one row per case with no account column, while the legacy list is one row per case account with the account number, balance, days past due and last contact on it, so the binding of the account columns to the case row is a target decision. Second, the read path: FSD A1.5 has the case list read the account columns from v_ace_account by case_list_row.account_key, Architecture v5 slide 8 grants the thirty recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone, slide 10 has gateway-bff call rwb-case and rwb-source-data in parallel and merge them, and DP-05 sends ACE data through the rwb-source-data contract, so three sources place the account read in three different components and none states which call carries a page of cases. Third, the freshness stamp: the API specification adds the response header X-Data-As-Of and the legacy rows carry a refresh time, but no source says whether the refresh time of a read-time list is the answer time or a stored build time, and the freshness resource itself is RWB-P1-E1015-CON's. Fourth, the removal: DP-17 removes the data lake, so case_list_row, its unique key, the extract file, the outbound adapter and the 07:30 data set have no owner in the target, and the reconciliation that passed or failed the publish (REC-01, REC-05, and the ALLOCATION_COMPLETE and PUBLISHED checks of the JOB-04 run) is not re-homed by any source. Fifth, the dependency rows: the WP fixes build, contract, integration and external dependencies as None while four DP rows of the story add a platform contract each, so the story needs one stated reading of that. The field identifiers of the parameter rows behind the threshold, the tolerance and the wait time, and of the LOV rows behind the filters, are also absent from the legacy data table and the FSD field catalog. The eleven legacy criteria carry no story-scoped identifier that the target could copy as its own, which is why the criteria of this story are reworked rather than preserved.
evidence: RWB-E1-002 sections 4 step 3 to 5 (read CaseQueryApi.openCaseAccounts, join v_ace_account, read v_ace_efs_action), 12 (job step, CaseQueryApi interface, GET /admin/jobs) and 13 (case_list_row, uk_case_list_row UNIQUE (business_date), feature flag rwb.p1.case-list, lake path); TSD P3 v3 T-A.2 API-P3-001 response CasePage and T5.2 (P1 for ACE case data); API Specification v4 GET /cases description ('response header X-Data-As-Of', filters, Case schema without account columns); FSD P3 v4 A1.5 ('Case list. SCR-02 and every queue view read ... the account columns ... from v_ace_account by case_list_row.account_key') and A2.19 integration points; Architecture v5 slide 8 (views read only by rwb-source-data), slide 10 (two parallel calls merged in gateway-bff); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-05, DP-11, DP-17 and R3 default ruling (case list API is P3 rwb-case).
legacy_ref: RWB-E1-002 (AC1, AC2, AC3, AC5, AC9, AC10, section 12, section 13)
proposed: Publish the list as one CaseListRow per open case carrying its account keys and the account columns of the legacy list; have rwb-case read the account and freshness answers of RWB-P1-E1015-CON for one page, one hop with a 2 s budget; stamp the row with the answer time as refreshedAt and the freshness answer as X-Data-As-Of with a stale flag; drop case_list_row, its key, the extract file, the lake path and the data set under DP-17; and leave REC-01 and REC-05 with RWB-P1-E1011 in rwb-source-data.
